# Team notes

Be thorough and follow best practices. Try to use good judgment where possible.

- Always indent with tabs.
- Use 2-space indentation everywhere.
- Never deploy on Fridays.
- Deploy on Fridays only after 4pm.

See [the checklist](references/checklist.md) and scripts/run.sh for details.
